name: diag-osd
summary: DIAGNOSTIC: VCP 0xEE reads/writes one byte of the OSD register bank 0x101C00-0x101DFF at the diag-poke address (font RAM, tile RAM, windows; tools/osdtest.sh)
status: diagnostic; v1 closed the menu on every DDC write (hardware 2026-10-09); v2 keeps it open for 0xEA-0xEE, untested

edits.asm: osd_set / osd_get (image head zero area 0x202600): VCP 0xEE, OSD bank only, plain RIU byte access
diag-fe SET fall-through (movhi r7,0x48) -> j osd_set
diag-poke GET fall-through (movhi r23,0x48) -> j osd_get
vendor close-menu-on-SET (movhi r7,0x45) -> j osd_keep: not for VCP 0xEA-0xEE

notes: Address: diag-poke's VCP 0xEA/0xEB. SET 0xEE = byte (<= 0xFF) written with sub_23D9E7 when the address is in 0x101C00-0x101DFF; GET 0xEE reads with sub_23D972 (0xFFFF outside the bank and for the data port 0x101C66). RAM 0x2024B0 counts accepted writes, 0x2024B1 = 1 after a refused one. Only OSD display state can change; a redraw or power cycle restores it. v2: an open menu is no longer closed by SETs of VCP 0xEA-0xEE (the vendor closes it on any SET, 0x26B211).
